prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape art-direction comparison board for a tile-based dark dungeon RPG. Three equal-width columns, same HUMAN WARRIOR, same equipment and same scale in each, but three genuinely distinct rendering and silhouette styles. Reference image is our actual dungeon material atlas: use its first-row charcoal warm-grey flagstone floor pattern as the environment under EACH character, not the whole atlas. Each column shows one large clear character on a small identical square patch of that floor, plus one smaller actual-game-scale rendition of the same character below on matching floor to judge readability. Quiet neutral charcoal board backdrop, subtle panel spacing. Small column headings EXACTLY 'A', 'B', 'C', no other text. Consistent character identity: adult human, short dark brown hair, warm tan skin, plain iron breastplate and shoulder protection over muted brown fabric, straight steel sword on viewer's right angled up/outward and small round wood shield with iron boss on viewer's left. Same neutral south-facing idle pose and modest elevated orthographic view in all columns. No helmets so faces and proportions can be compared. Tight coherent muted palette, clean charcoal outlines, only 2-3 broad value planes, no tiny textures. All character bodies compact, NOT elongated. Head distinctly narrower than shoulders. Armor, head, shield and weapon should have clearly separable shapes suitable for interchangeable sprite layers. Equipment must be legible outside body silhouette. A: COMPACT TACTICAL BUST. Head, broad armored shoulders and short chest ending just below breastplate, no legs, no pedestal. Adult facial indication with simple eyebrows and short nose shadow, not blank egg face or cute dot eyes. Slightly angular hand-illustrated outline, broad clean flat colors. Character body width nearly equal to total height excluding sword. Strong chest/shoulder silhouette like a simplified tactical board-game bust, absolutely not a bean-shaped colony pawn. B: PAPER CUTOUT. Compact squat full-body paper puppet, small head, angular cut-paper shoulder plates and torso, stubby legs and two clear short boots, arms implied as two flat sleeve shapes. Bold economical angular silhouette and overlapping flat colored paper pieces, almost no shading, no realistic paper texture. Same breastplate sword and shield as A. C: CARVED WOOD MINIATURE. Compact full-body board-game figurine with short stout legs, broad shoulders, subtly faceted head and chest, simplified carved wedge nose and brow. Depict as a 2D sprite illustration with 3 broad flat tonal facets, not photorealistic 3D. Painted iron-grey armor and subdued brown accents, no woodgrain texture, no base or stand. Distinctly solid carved silhouette, no round chibi head. All three integrate with the supplied floor's bold joints and simple slab geometry. Large main versions occupy upper two thirds of board and small readability samples occupy bottom third. Readability samples must duplicate the corresponding main design, not introduce new characters. No scene props, dramatic lighting, glow, gradients, ornamental details, extra gear, photorealism, pixel art, UI or watermarks. This is a style comparison, not production-ready separate layers.
